title: A Thresholding Based Operator-Splitting Method for Curvature-Regularized Surface Reconstruction
summary: Surface reconstruction from point clouds is a fundamental problem in computational geometry with broad applications in computer graphics, medical imaging, and manufacturing. In this paper, we propose an efficient method for solving a curvature-regularized surface reconstruction model. To avoid the computational cost associated with reinitialization in traditional level set methods, we represent the reconstructed surface by an indicator function.
